title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_en: The Bird Startled by the Bow
summary_zh: 本页展示了绘本标题“惊弓之鸟”，背景为蓝天和绿色树冠，一只鸟在空中飞翔，画面简洁明快，引出故事主题。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh:
俺是射箭高手......
战国时，魏国有一个叫更羸的射箭能手
page_text_en:
I'm a great archer......
During the Warring States period, there was an archer named Geng Lei in the State of Wei.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了战国时期魏国的射箭能手更羸，画面中他手持奖杯，自信地宣称自己是射箭高手。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh: 有一天，更羸与魏王在京台之下看见有一只鸟从头顶飞过
page_text_en: One day, Geng Lei and King Wei saw a bird flying overhead beneath the Jing Terrace.
summary_zh: 更羸与魏王在京台之下看见一只鸟从头顶飞过。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh:
更羸对魏王说：“王，我可以不用箭，只要拉一下弓，这只大雁就能掉下来。”
“箭能达到这样的功夫？”魏王问。
更羸说道：“可以。”
page_text_en:
Geng Lei said to King Wei: "Your Majesty, I don't need an arrow. Just by drawing my bow once, this goose will fall down." 
"Can an arrow achieve such skill?" asked King Wei. 
Geng Lei replied: "Yes, it can."
summary_zh: 更羸向魏王夸下海口，声称无需射箭，仅凭拉弓就能让飞过的大雁坠落，魏王对此表示怀疑，更羸则自信地答应可以做到。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh: 当雁飞近时，只见更羸举起弓，不用箭，拉了一下弦。
page_text_en: When the goose flew closer, everyone saw Geng Lei raise his bow, without an arrow, and pull the string once.
summary_zh: 更羸在大雁飞近时，举起弓弦，但并未射箭，仅拉了一下弦。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh: 随着咚的一声，正飞着的大雁就从半空中掉了下来。
page_text_en: With a 'dong' sound, the goose flying in the air fell from the sky.
summary_zh: 随着弓弦被拉响，正在飞行的大雁从空中坠落，画面中一只兔子在旁观看。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh: 魏王看到后大吃一惊，连声说：“真有这样的事情！不用箭怎么将空中飞着的雁射下来的？”
page_text_en: The King of Wei was greatly surprised and exclaimed, “Is there really such a thing? How can you shoot down a goose flying in the sky without using an arrow?”
summary_zh: 魏王目睹更羸仅拉弓弦便使大雁坠落，感到震惊并提出疑问。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh: 更羸对魏王讲：“没什么，这是一只受过箭伤的大雁。”
page_text_en: Geng Lei told King Wei: "Nothing to worry about, this is a goose that has been wounded by an arrow."
summary_zh: 更羸向魏王解释，坠落的大雁是因为受过箭伤，而非被射中。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh:
“你怎么知道大雁受过伤呢？”魏王更加好奇了。
更羸继续对魏王说：“这只大雁飞得慢，叫得悲。飞得慢是因为旧伤疼痛，叫得悲是因为它离开同伴很久了。”
page_text_en:
"How do you know the goose was injured?" The King of Wei became even more curious.
Geng Lei continued to explain to the King of Wei: "This goose flies slowly and calls mournfully. It flies slowly because of the pain from its old wound, and it calls mournfully because it has been separated from its companions for a long time."
summary_zh: 魏王对更羸能仅凭拉弓弦就使大雁坠落感到好奇，询问其原因。更羸解释说，大雁飞得慢是因为旧伤疼痛，叫得悲是因为离开同伴很久，从而揭示了大雁坠落的真正原因。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh: 更羸继续说：“伤口还在作痛，它心里又害怕，当听到弓弦声响后，害怕再次被射中，于是拼命往高处飞。”
page_text_en: Geng Lei continued, "Its wound is still painful, and it is frightened. When it hears the sound of the bowstring, it fears being shot again, so it desperately flies higher."
summary_zh: 更羸向魏王解释大雁坠落的原因，说明大雁因旧伤未愈且心生恐惧，在听到弓弦声后拼命高飞，最终因体力不支而坠落。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh: “一使劲本来未愈合的伤口又裂开了。疼痛难忍，再也飞不动了。”
page_text_en: "When it strained, the wound that hadn't healed yet tore open again. The pain was unbearable, and it couldn't fly anymore."
summary_zh: 画面展示了一只大雁的特写，其眼中含泪，下方文字解释了它因旧伤在受惊后再次裂开、疼痛难忍而无法飞行的原因。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
summary_zh: 画面中一只大雁从空中坠落，下方文字描述其坠落的情景，呼应前文更羸拉弓弦导致大雁坠落的事件。

title_en: The Bird Startled by the Sound of a Bow
page_text_ocr_zh:
思考
这个成语故事是比喻经过
惊吓的人，碰到一点动静
就会非常害怕，反过来说，
它告诉我们做人要光明磊
落，这样就会过得比较心
安踏实。
page_text_en:
Thinking
This idiom story is a metaphor for people who have been frightened; they will become very afraid at even the slightest movement. On the contrary, it tells us that we should be upright and honest in our conduct, so that we can live with peace of mind and feel more at ease.
summary_zh: 本页通过一只思考的狮子形象，总结了前文成语故事的寓意：受过惊吓的人容易因小事而恐惧，而做人应光明磊落，才能心安踏实。
